$comment: The result of updateChange, in actionFinished. A change that is null means the update failed, and `refused` says why. An update changes the change outside the order of the item's events, so `observed` is the change as the host reads it when it handles this result, as for a publish: it is null when the host could not read each field in time or found the change closed unmerged, and the item then has no observation until the next one.
